verdict.rationale: Cline ships as an IDE extension for VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, JetBrains and others, and also works in Zed and Neovim via ACP. It describes itself as an AI coding assistant in your editor that works through natural conversation. Plan mode lets it read the codebase and discuss strategy, with conversation history persisting across modes. Community users describe planning sessions with it for 10–15 minutes. Missing for 10: no documentation of in-IDE context-referencing mechanics (e.g., mentioning files or selections in the chat panel), and the hands-on corroboration does not specifically describe the in-editor chat experience.
